title: The Mines and Minerals Development Act, 2015
sponsoringMinistry: Ministry of Mines and Minerals Development

sections.title: Short title and commencement
sections.content: This Act may be cited as the Mines and Minerals Development Act, 2015, and shall come into operation on such date as the Minister may, by statutory instrument, appoint.

sections.title: Interpretation
sections.content: In this Act, unless the context otherwise requires— 'base metal' means a non-precious metal that is either common or more chemically active, or both common and chemically active; 'mineral' means any substance occurring naturally in or on the earth or in or under water and which was formed by or subjected to a geological process...

sections.title: Director of Mines
sections.content: The Public Service Commission shall appoint as public officers a Director of Mines, a Director of Geological Survey, a Director of Mines Safety and a Director of Mining Cadastre.

sections.title: Prohibition of mining without mining right
sections.content: A person shall not prospect for minerals or carry on mining operations except under the authority of a mining right or mineral processing licence granted under this Act.

sections.title: Application for large-scale mining licence
sections.content: An application for a large-scale mining licence shall be made to the Director of Mining Cadastre in the prescribed form upon payment of the prescribed fee.
